title: Event-Driven Architecture Testing — In-Memory Broker + Test Suite
title_es: Testing de Arquitectura Event-Driven — Broker en memoria + suite de tests
description: A stdlib Python in-memory broker modeling topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets, retries→DLQ, retention and consumer lag — plus an idempotent-consumer pattern keyed on correlation_id and a CQRS read model. Pytest suite covers ordering, at-least-once dedup, rebalancing, poison messages, retention loss and read-model convergence.
description_es: Broker en memoria stdlib de Python que modela topics, particiones, consumer groups, offsets, reintentos→DLQ, retención y consumer lag — más un patrón de consumer idempotente por correlation_id y un read model CQRS. La suite pytest cubre orden, dedup at-least-once, rebalancing, poison messages, pérdida por retención y convergencia del read model.
